items.a: Yes. There is no paid plan, no account and no usage limit.

items.q: Does it send any data anywhere?
items.a: No. Rivaline reads the page in your browser and keeps the result in memory until you close the tab. Only your settings are saved, and only on your computer.
It matches script addresses, cookie names, page globals and meta tags against its own list of about 160 marketing tools. Every match shows the evidence it found.

items.q: Can it show a competitor's ad spend?
items.a: No. Ad libraries show which ads are running, not budgets. Rivaline opens those libraries with the search already filled in.

Yes. Read each site in its own tab, then press Compare in the panel. Rivaline puts the two results side by side: tools, ad channels, offers, social profiles, markets and brand colors. Nothing is saved.

items.q: Why do I click the icon again on a new tab?
items.a: Rivaline uses Chrome's activeTab permission. It can read a page only after you ask, so it never has access to every site you visit.

items.q: Why does TikTok show only European ads?
items.a: TikTok's ad library covers ads shown in the EU, the EEA, Switzerland and the UK. Rivaline fills in the brand and the country, then you press Search on TikTok's page.
